chapter.verse: Pasian aw, bang hangin kote hong paikhia paisuak na hi hiam? Bang hangin nangma gam sunga na tuute tungah heh na hi hiam?
Tanglai-a na ngahsa nangma mihonte, nangma luah minam dinga, na tatkhiatsate phawk in! Na ten’nasa Zion Mual phawk in.
A sia densa munah hong kalsuan in; biakinn sunga om nate khempeuh gal in susia khin ta!
Na galte, nangma mun siangtho laizangah awng uh a, amau lumte lim dingin suang uh hi.
Amaute pen, tuu-lak sing phatna sungah pai-in heipi tawh sing a phuk bang uh hi.
Tua ciangin biakinn na kizeemte khempeuh sek-hei leh sekpite tawh sat kham uh hi.
Amaute in nangma biakinn mei tawh hal uh a, nangmah hong kibiakna mun susia uh hi.
Amaute in, “A vekpi-in zomang khin ni,” kici uh a, gam sung teng-a om Pasian biakna inn khempeuh mei tawh hal uh hi.
Kote in ka mailam thu ding uh ka thei kei uh hi; kamsang khat zong om nawn lo a, bang tanvei hi ding ci-a a thei kuamah ka om kei uh hi.
Pasian aw, galte in bang tanvei hong thusim loin om ding ahi hiam? Langpangte in nangma min hong simmawh den ding ahi uh hiam?
Bang hangin na khut dok kik a, na khut taklam na ang sungah koih na hi hiam?
Ahi zongin Pasian in tanglai pek-a kipan kumpi hi a, leitungah hotkhiatna a sem ka Kumpi ahi hi.
Nangma vangliatna tawh tuipi na khenkham a, tuite tunga gulpite’ lutangte na sukham hi.
Nangmah in Awle’ lutangte na sukham a, amah pen, gamlak ganhingte’ nek dingin na pia hi.
Nangmah in ciktuite leh luite na phulsak a, guntui luangte na kangsak hi.
Sun in nangma aa hi a, zan zong nangma aa ahi hi; nangmah in ni leh kha na bawl hi.
Nangmah in leitung gamgi khempeuhte, phalbi hun leh khuakhal hunte na bawl khin hi.
Topa aw, galte in hong thusimlohna leh, dawi bia mite in nangma min a simmawhna thu uh phawk in.
A cimawh na mite, a gal gilote uh khut sungah nusia kei in la, bawlsiatna a thuak na mite mangngilh kei in.
Na thuciamna hong pingaihsut in; bang hang hiam cih leh leitung mun mialna khempeuh mi ngongtatte’ omna tawh kidim hi.
A kisikcip mite zahhuaisak kei in la, mizawngte leh mi cimawhte nangma min kiphatsak in.
Pasian aw, tho in la, nangma thu-ah hong pang in; dawi bia mite in sun tawntungin nangmah hong thusim lohna phawk ta in!
Nangma galte’ kikona aw, nang hong langpangte’ gamlum semsemna mangngilh kei ta in!
